earnings.title: PRESS RELEASE, DATED NOVEMBER 4, 2026
highlights: AppLovin posted record third quarter earnings: net income grew 72% year-over-year to $1.44 billion on record revenue of $2.18 billion, up 55% year-over-year, with industry-leading 66% net income margin and 84% Adjusted EBITDA margin.
Basic and Diluted earnings per share ("EPS") were $4.31 and $4.30, respectively, for the third quarter 2026.
